actions.reason: K4_C0004 has an interpretable but weak biological phenotype (partial RNA program with many pathways at fdr_q>0.1; only within-panel VHL/PBRM1 signals that do not survive global correction), and its membership is not positively represented in patient geometry: silhouettes are near zero or negative in CT, WSI, and RNA and only weakly positive in WXS, with within-set distances exceeding between-set distances in CT, WSI, and WXS (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:6e0bda1ea1). The set-level structural screen shows no meaningful internal separation (near-zero silhouettes) and, per its own semantics, provides no positive evidence of independence from neighbors (ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:6e0bda1ea1). The set-level confounder report shows no corrected-significant factor association, but nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding and cannot substitute for positive membership evidence (ER:...confounder_association:set:6e0bda1ea1). With decision-relevant evidence exhausted and no positive basis for treating current membership as an independent unit, retention is not justified.

K4_C0003 has a coherent immune/inflammatory RNA phenotype and BAP1 enrichment surviving global correction, so its biological identity is interpretable (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5; ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:42fb02ccf5). However, membership representation in native geometry is only weakly positive (silhouettes 0.035-0.098 with small within/between distance differences), and the set-level structural screen shows no meaningful internal separation while explicitly providing no positive evidence of independence from neighbors (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:42fb02ccf5; ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:42fb02ccf5). A material alternative remains: tissue_source_site is significantly associated with K4_C0003 membership (V=0.443, q=0.009) with visible imbalance (CJ concentrated in the set), and ct_slice_thickness/ct_z_spacing differ significantly (ER:...confounder_association:set:42fb02ccf5). This association is not proof of artifact, but it is a plausible site/acquisition alternative that is not neutralized, and no evidence directly establishes an independent boundary. Independent retention is therefore not positively justified.

K4_C0002 has a coherent metabolic RNA phenotype and strong VHL depletion surviving global correction, so its biological identity is interpretable (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e; ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:fc5a03698e). Membership representation is only modestly positive (silhouettes 0.011-0.177, largest in WXS), and the set-level structural screen shows no meaningful internal separation and provides no positive evidence of independence from neighbors (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:fc5a03698e; ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:fc5a03698e). Critically, a material alternative remains: tissue_source_site (V=0.428, q=0.0018), ct_manufacturer (V=0.353, q=0.0018), ct_scanner_model (V=0.374, q=0.0075), ct_reconstruction_kernel (V=0.387, q=0.0018), and ct_slice_thickness/ct_z_spacing all show corrected-significant association with K4_C0002 membership, with visible imbalance (B8 concentrated, BP depleted, Siemens enriched) (ER:...confounder_association:set:fc5a03698e). This is association, not proven artifact, but it is a substantial unadjusted site/acquisition alternative that is not neutralized, and no evidence directly establishes an independent boundary. Independent retention is not positively justified.

K4_C0001 has a coherent down-regulated OXPHOS/immune RNA phenotype and strong PBRM1 enrichment surviving global correction, so its biological identity is interpretable (ER:...rna_pathway_enrichment:set:e5313ac502; ER:...wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:e5313ac502). However, membership representation in native geometry is weak: silhouettes are small and positive (0.003-0.090) with within-set and between-set distances nearly indistinguishable and slightly reversed in WSI (ER:...affinity_geometry_concordance:set:e5313ac502). The set-level structural screen shows no meaningful internal separation and, per its semantics, provides no positive evidence of independence from neighbors (ER:...structural_diagnostics:set:e5313ac502). The set-level confounder report shows no corrected-significant factor association, but nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding and cannot substitute for positive membership evidence (ER:...confounder_association:set:e5313ac502). With no evidence directly establishing an independent boundary and decision-relevant evidence exhausted, independent retention is not positively justified.
